output.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) AS discount_2025_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Sums the line discounts (discount_amount, in EUR) on completed orders (is_revenue is true) with an order date in calendar year 2025. Cancelled, returned and open orders are excluded.
